description: Final YottaFlex 2.0.0 evidence summary, re-verified 2026-10-29 from fresh main and clean-environment runs. Metrics are read from each evaluation_metrics.json; exact-100k evidence is in reports/final/yf2-100k/ and the historical 99k compact run is in reports/final/yf2-compact-99k/.

event_level.false_positive_rate_denominator: normal windows with an alarm / all normal windows

matching_policy.unit: alarm incident (overlapping alarm episodes for one equipment merged)
matching_policy.sensor: alarm incident must include the expected sensor when one is defined; ambiguous sensor evidence may match
matching_policy.category: expected_alarm_category must be present in the incident category set
matching_policy.timing: incident onset must be no earlier than event start minus pre-event tolerance and no later than event start plus the category-specific permitted latency
matching_policy.duplicate_handling: alarm grouping plus incident merging; corroborating alarm events are not counted as TP
matching_policy.false_positive_rate_unit: normal ground-truth window with an unmatched incident
matching_policy.ambiguity: If one incident overlaps multiple events, a deterministic greedy assignment gives it to the closest event; the other event is a false negative. Late alarms are an incident false alarm and the event is a false negative. An alarm before the event (outside tolerance) does not count as a detection of that event.

point_level.positive_class: A (sensor, timestamp) sample inside an explicit injected-anomaly window for that sensor's expected observable. One sample = one unit.

policy.positive_class: A (sensor, timestamp) sample inside an explicit injected-anomaly window for that sensor's expected observable. One sample = one unit.
policy.negative_class: A (sensor, timestamp) sample inside an explicit NORMAL ground-truth window. Unlabelled samples are UNKNOWN and excluded.
policy.timestamp_matching: Exact sample timestamp equality; alarm episodes cover first..last detected timestamps inclusive.
policy.missing_label_policy: Unknown labels are excluded and counted; a missing measurement is excluded even inside a labelled window.
policy.missing_measurement_policy: Rows with null measured_value or quality_status=MISSING are excluded as unobserved.

remediation_2026_10_28.reproducibility: main environment exact-a/b: 20/23 byte-identical; 3 timestamp-only differences; SQLite logical equality across 19 tables. Clean environment exact-100k: 19/23 byte-identical; 3 timestamp-only plus one last-bit float report difference; 17/19 SQLite tables exactly equal.
remediation_2026_10_28.portable_exports: CSV, SQLite, per-table JSON (18 tables / 101,275 rows) and portable SQL seed (101,275 rows) verified; SQL seed executed into a new database.
remediation_2026_10_28.publication: authorized by the user on 2026-10-28; final push to origin/main performed after the final audit and commit

clean_environment.install: python -m venv; python -m pip install -e .; python -m pip install pytest

validation_reconciliation.source: all reports/final/*/validation_results.csv files read directly, plus the fresh 2026-10-29 main and clean exact/full/default/evaluation runs

review_level_caveats.item: prompt completeness for earlier reconstructed records
clean-environment installation, 68-test suite, exact-100k, full/default and evaluation reruns
cross-version last-bit float serialization; no metric or semantic change

validation_reconciliation.publication: authorized on 2026-10-28 and reaffirmed by the 2026-10-29 final-audit instruction; publication is limited to the confirmed origin main branch
validation_reconciliation.final_acceptance_evidence: Fresh 2026-10-29 external runs baseline-100k, baseline-100k-b, exact-clean-current, full-default, evaluation, full-default-clean-current and evaluation-clean-current; commands, checksums, independent metrics and clean-environment comparison are in reproducibility_100k.json. Five negative controls and state-history tests passed; no source logic changed.

independent_recompute.duplicate_handling: 15 alarm episodes merged into 10 incidents; 5 corroborating episodes did not inflate event TP
independent_recompute.unknown_handling: 203,490 unlabelled samples excluded; 2 predictions outside label windows reported but not counted as FP
independent_recompute.sensor_fault_classification: 4/4 sensor-fault events matched SENSOR_FAULT incidents; process events remained PROCESS_FAULT

light_leak.reason: decline corroboration and 480 s persistence do not both hold

review_level_caveats.item: light-leak sensitivity; RULE-006 corroboration and 480 s persistence are not both met
earlier 1.x and 2026-10-28 prompt records are reconstructed because their verbatim text was not retained
cross-version last-bit float serialization differences in one SQL report and two SQLite tables; no metric or semantic change

repository.changes_in_this_audit: Documentation, machine-readable evidence, the light-leak diagnostic and AI-use/prompt records only.
repository.publication: Authorized for the confirmed remote; reviewed documentation/evidence changes committed and pushed to main without force.

final_acceptance_20261029.notes: Fresh 2026-10-29 rerun: 68 main tests in 43.31 s, 17 targeted tests in 31.56 s, 68 clean-environment tests in 34.52 s, two exact-100k main runs, fresh clean exact/full/default/evaluation runs, exports, independent metrics, five negative controls and prompt-history audit. No source logic, thresholds, labels, scenarios or matching rules changed.
